news.title: Sakurazaka46 “6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE” - Ticket Entries for Overseas Fans Start October 10 at 12:00 noon JST!
news.content:
We are pleased to announce that overseas fan tickets for the “6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE” will be available for purchase!

Once again, with support from Tixplus, we have prepared a dedicated application form and ticket issuance system for Sakurazaka46.

Ticket lottery applications for overseas fans to Sakurazaka46's “6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE” will open on Saturday, October 10th, starting at 12:00 noon Japan Standard Time.

We look forward to receiving your applications!
Welcome to Japan!


<Performance>
Sakurazaka46 “6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE”
“Rina Matsuda Graduation Ceremony” (November 15 performance only)

【Performers】
Sakurazaka46
*Participating members are subject to change without notice. We appreciate your understanding.

【Date】
November 14 (Sat.), 2026 Doors open at 3:30 PM / Performance begins at 5:30 PM
November 15 (Sun.), 2026 Doors open at 3:00 PM / Performance begins at 5:00 PM

【Venue】
ZOZO Marine Stadium

【Admission】
Reserved Seat: 12,000 yen (tax incl.)

【Notes】
*Please be sure to bring your passport to the venue on the day of the performance.
*Upon entry, we will verify your identity using your ticket and the passport you have with you.
If we cannot verify your identity, we may deny you entry.
*Children aged 3 and older require a paid ticket.
However, if a seat is required, even children aged 2 and under need one ticket per person.
Children aged 2 and under who do not require a seat may sit on the lap of a guardian, limited to one child per guardian.
*All attendees will undergo baggage inspection and metal detector screening.
*The organizers may publicly share video and photographic recordings taken within the venue, including the audience area.
*Bringing alcohol into the venue is prohibited on the day of the event. Entry will also be denied to anyone under the influence of alcohol.

【Pre-Ticketing Application for Overseas Fans】
<Application Period> October 10 (Sat.), 12:00 noon to October 19 (Mon.), 11:59 PM
https://tixplus.jp/feature/sakurazaka46/6th_anniversary/en_v6ez2/

Important Notes Regarding Advance Registration ※Please read carefully
*All tickets will be delivered as smartphone e-tickets.
Receiving tickets requires registration (free) with the Tixplus e-ticket app, which must be completed during the ticket application process.
The person attending the event must apply for the tickets themselves.
Name changes after application will not be accepted.
Transferring tickets between family members or friends is strictly prohibited.
No changes will be accepted for any reason whatsoever. Please ensure all information is correct and complete when applying.
Admission will be denied to anyone other than the registered applicant, regardless of reason.
*Please note that no refunds of any kind will be issued for the ticket price or other charges, even if you are unable to enter the venue.

*Pre-ticketing is a method that provides an opportunity to purchase tickets prior to the general sale.
All seats are assigned by lottery, so we cannot guarantee that seats in the front rows will be available.
*We do not guarantee the validity of tickets purchased through auction sites, ticket resale shops, or private transactions.
Ticket transfer or resale is strictly prohibited.

*This performance is subject to the “Act Against Unfair Resale of Tickets”.

＜Regarding Electronic Ticket Applications＞
■ Both the applicant and accompanying guests must register for a free Tixplus membership to use electronic tickets.
Register for freehere
■ When applying, proceed using the applicant's Plus member ID and password. You will need to enter the accompanying guest's Plus member ID and registered phone number.
When applying for two tickets, please have the accompanying person's Plus member ID and registered phone number ready in advance.
■ If the phone number is incorrectly registered, the ticket cannot be displayed. Please ensure the number is entered correctly.
　We cannot accommodate phone number changes after application.
■ For inquiries regarding electronic tickets, please use the contact form below.
https://tixplus.jp/feature/ticket_faq/en.html

■Applications are not processed on a first-come, first-served basis. This is a lottery system, so please apply at your convenience during the application period.
■Lottery results will be announced after 6:00 PM on Thursday, October 24 (JST).

■Limited to two tickets per person.
■Applications are limited to one per person per performance. (You may apply to multiple performances)
■We cannot accommodate applications in which the applicant and accompanying person are swapped, or in which the desired ticket type is changed. Refunds will not be issued in the unlikely event of duplicate wins.
■In addition to the ticket price, various fees such as a system usage fee will be charged at the time of purchase.
■For wheelchair users attending the performance, please contact the inquiry desk after your ticket has been issued and at least 3 days before the performance date. Be sure to provide: [①Name ②Phone Number (a number where you can be reached on the day of the performance) ③Whether accompanied or not (Name of Companion) ④Seat Type ⑤Seat Number]. We will guide you to the wheelchair viewing area.
If you attend without having contacted us in advance, it may be difficult to secure space, and we may be unable to guide you into the venue.
Only one companion may accompany individuals requiring assistance, but a ticket is required for the companion. Depending on circumstances, the companion may be asked to watch from their own seat.
As a general rule, use of the wheelchair viewing area is limited to those who need to use a wheelchair for mobility or who hold a disability certificate; however, if you wish to use the wheelchair viewing area for some other reason, please contact us first. We may ask to see proof of disability, such as a disability certificate, for verification purposes. Please note that we cannot inform you where the viewing area will be in advance, as it is subject to change based on the venue conditions on the day of the event.
■ Purchases for resale are strictly prohibited.
■ When purchasing multiple tickets, seats next to each other may not be available.
■ Purchased tickets cannot be exchanged, modified, or canceled for any reason.
■Please note in advance that the various fees will not be refunded if the performance is canceled or in similar circumstances.
■ Payment Methods
・Credit Card
・PayPal
・UnionPay

【Inquiries about the performance】
Live Exsam　https://www.liveexsam.co.jp/contact_sakamichi/
